metadata.description: The single xgodev Claude Code marketplace: every xgodev plugin, each shipped from its own repository.

plugins.name: claude-plugin
plugins.description: Umbrella Claude Code plugin: bundles no skills of its own; pulls golang-boost, quality-gate, dev-rules and skill-rules as same-marketplace dependencies and wires the playwright MCP.

plugins.name: golang-boost
plugins.description: Single-entry, grouped-index skill for github.com/xgodev/boost -- skills/boost/SKILL.md lists 8 top-level contexts, each expanding into a group/domain file before reaching a per-component leaf, so only the small top-level index loads on every trigger. Pulls in quality-gate for the pre-push comparative gate as a dependency.

plugins.name: quality-gate
plugins.description: Quality Gate dispatcher + per-language gates + the quality-gate skill.

plugins.name: dev-rules
plugins.description: A macro, language-agnostic engineering-discipline skill that governs how code is written, edited, and refactored: data ownership, zero coupling, single source of truth, RED-first TDD, docs-synced commits, verify-before-done, and concurrency-first design. Ships language-agnostic RED-first enforcement hooks.

plugins.name: skill-rules
plugins.description: Discipline skill: every Claude skill must be portable across all developers and machines -- no environment-tied hardcoding (home/user paths, absolute paths to other repos, pinned plugin versions).
